scope: Exactly four genuinely distinct, non-L14, China-native supplemental candidates. This file does not modify the longlist, source ledger, selection, or shared state.

binding_interpretation.G1: Two independent current demand sources are required, including at least one primary buyer procurement or filing. A startup-specific feature may be new, but the paid category and painful job must already exist.
binding_interpretation.G2: No academic claim is load-bearing unless the cited work is final and peer-review verified.
binding_interpretation.G6: A China flag requires a lawful reachable route; no India or Singapore market evidence is used.
binding_interpretation.G7: Each candidate has bounded 2026-2029 de-risking, a named 2030-2034 trigger, and at least two independent timing sources including an official source relevant to 2028-2035.
binding_interpretation.founder_fit_cap: Founder-skill-transfer remains only 2/100 of the total weighted score.

decision_summary.portfolio_note: All four clear the literal gates on the evidence assembled here, but the helium and arsine-abatement entries remain deliberately discounted for incumbent absorption and narrower market routes. ADVANCE_TO_REDTEAM is not a final-selection recommendation.

candidates.concept: Retrofit X-ray computed-laminography kit for advanced-packaging failure analysis
named_buyer_examples: Guangzhou Guangxin Packaging Substrate and Wuxi Shennan Circuits X-ray inspection teams (CN)
NIST CHIPS advanced-packaging metrology programs and US packaging failure-analysis laboratories (US)
candidates.painful_job: Flat multilayer substrates and advanced packages hide cracks, voids, bridges, and layer offsets behind overlapping 2D projections. Buyers already procure X-ray inspection cabinets, while high-resolution CT/XRM systems are costly, slow, and usually sold as complete cabinets.
candidates.product: A tilted precision stage, cabinet-specific geometry calibration target, sparse-view reconstruction software, and package-defect classifier retrofitted to qualifying installed 2D X-ray cabinets. It does not replace the X-ray source or shielding enclosure.
candidates.noncosmetic_wedge: ZEISS, Sigray, Nikon, and Nordson sell complete inspection systems. The wedge is installed-base reuse plus tilted laminography geometry for flat packages, with a two-brand calibration and repeatability dossier. A software-only classifier would be cosmetic; the stage, geometry calibration, and cabinet-compatibility qualification are the product.
candidates.precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026-2027: build the tilted-stage and calibration stack on rented or partner cabinets. 2028: blinded coupon study and two-cabinet-brand port. 2029: paid evaluation at one CN substrate/package facility and one US failure-analysis laboratory; freeze the compatibility list and service procedure.
candidates.launch_2030_timing_thesis: JCET's Lingang advanced-packaging factory has phase-one production-equipment completion targeted for H2 2028, while the official 2026-2030 national plan calls for decisive integrated-circuit breakthroughs. A 2030 launch enters the post-installation yield-learning and recurring failure-analysis cycle rather than trying to win the original cabinet order.
candidates.demand_trigger_2030_2034: Yield ramp, package-mix expansion, and service retrofits after 2028 advanced-packaging tool installation, plus recurring US CHIPS metrology and failure-analysis demand. Revalidate the installed 2D-cabinet population and paid retrofit appetite in 2029.
candidates.competition_outlook_2030: Complete-cabinet competitors include ZEISS Versa XRM 730, Sigray Apex-class systems, Nikon XT H, and Nordson DAGE Quadra. They can add laminography modes or discount new cabinets. The thesis survives only if a retrofit produces useful 3D defect separation on at least two installed cabinet brands at a small fraction of cabinet-replacement cost.
candidates.china_route: Sell a locally integrated stage, calibration artifact, and independently developed reconstruction stack to civilian semiconductor packaging and substrate plants. No controlled US source design is transferred; screen end users and exclude restricted military or surveillance uses.

first_experiment.design: Use one rented and one partner 2D X-ray cabinet to image 100 blinded flat-package or substrate coupons with seeded 10-30 micrometre void, crack, bridge, and layer-offset defects. Compare against destructive sectioning or trusted reference CT.
success_thresholds: >=90% sensitivity across the prespecified seeded-defect set
<=5 minutes per package or <=10 minutes per panel coupon
installation on two cabinet brands without source or shielding modification
kill_thresholds: Any sensitivity, false-positive, throughput, or repeatability threshold misses after the frozen calibration protocol
Porting requires cabinet-source modification or vendor-locked service access
No paid evaluation or buyer LOI after the witnessed blinded study

G1.rationale: Two independent MOFCOM buyer procurements establish active X-ray inspection purchasing, and NIST separately procures high-resolution XRM for semiconductor-package metrology.

G2.rationale: The load-bearing technical claim is supported by a final 2025 peer-reviewed Microelectronics Reliability paper; achieved startup performance is not assumed.

G3.rationale: A 12-month $92k experiment has frozen blinded-detection, speed, repeatability, compatibility, and buyer kill criteria.

G4.rationale: Exact complete-system competitors are named. Installed-cabinet retrofit is noncosmetic, but incumbents can absorb the geometry mode.

G5.rationale: Tilted laminography and sparse-view reconstruction are demonstrated; the experiment falsifies whether cabinet geometry and signal quality are sufficient.

G6.rationale: Civilian packaging plants are reachable through local integration and independent software, with end-use screening and no controlled source transfer.

G7.rationale: H2-2028 advanced-packaging equipment completion, the official 2026-2030 IC program, and continuing NIST metrology procurement support a specific 2030 post-install yield-ramp window.

candidates.concept: Field-deployable industrial high-temperature heat-pump commissioning and measurement-and-verification island
named_buyer_examples: Industrial heat-pump integrators and owners responding to MIIT variable-load efficiency requirements (CN)
US ESCOs and high-temperature heat-pump field-demonstration teams (US)
candidates.painful_job: Industrial heat-pump projects are accepted using inconsistent boundaries and steady-state snapshots even though auxiliary loads, variable flow, steam quality, fouling, and transient operation determine actual savings. Integrators need a defensible field acceptance dossier, not another laboratory nameplate test.
candidates.product: A portable island of nonintrusive electrical metering, clamp-on ultrasonic flow, calibrated temperature and pressure sensing, steam-enthalpy estimation, synchronized acquisition, uncertainty propagation, and a boundary-defined transient COP/exergy report.
candidates.noncosmetic_wedge: Intertek, TÜV SÜD, AHRI programs, and national laboratories provide certification and rig testing. The wedge is rapid on-site whole-boundary transient M&V under actual variable load, including auxiliaries and steam delivery. MIIT's stated need for wide-range actual-load evaluation makes this more than a reporting interface.
candidates.precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026: freeze boundary and uncertainty protocol. 2027: instrument a 300 kW-3 MW partner loop. 2028: complete two seasonal field deployments and obtain third-party sensor calibration. 2029: win one paid commissioning engagement in CN and one US demonstration or ESCO evaluation.
candidates.launch_2030_timing_thesis: China's official heat-pump action plan sets 2030 deployment and industrialization objectives, while MIIT's 2026-2028 program explicitly calls for industrial heat pumps and wide-range actual-load efficiency evaluation. The validation window precedes the scale-up and acceptance wave.
candidates.demand_trigger_2030_2034: Industrial-steam and waste-heat projects installed under the 2026-2030 action-plan cycle reach acceptance, optimization, and performance-guarantee review. In the US, ongoing DOE high-temperature-heat-pump demonstrations provide a partner route, but the US beachhead is conditional on a paid 2029 field engagement.
candidates.competition_outlook_2030: Large test houses can extend into field M&V and heat-pump OEMs can bundle sensors. The candidate wins only if it closes a whole-system energy balance faster and more accurately than ad hoc consultant instrumentation, with a reusable acceptance protocol.
candidates.china_route: Use locally sourced instrumentation and domestic calibration laboratories; sell field commissioning to civilian industrial owners, integrators, and energy-service firms. No restricted technology transfer is required.

first_experiment.design: Instrument one partner heat-pump loop between 300 kW and 3 MW, compare against traceable reference calorimetry, and introduce blinded operating changes that create approximately 5% degradation.
success_thresholds: Whole-boundary energy-balance closure <=2% at stable points
Transient COP uncertainty <=3% across the prespecified operating envelope
Detect the blinded 5% degradation with >=90% sensitivity
Installation completed in <2 site days and signed report delivered in <24 hours after data close
kill_thresholds: Fails any field accuracy or degradation-detection threshold
Requires invasive plant modifications beyond standard ports
No paid pilot after two witnessed field trials

G1.rationale: Tongji procures exact heat-pump coupled demonstration/testing service, while NDRC and MIIT independently establish funded deployment and real-load evaluation demand.

G2.rationale: A final peer-reviewed monitoring-framework paper supports the measurement problem; no projected product accuracy is borrowed from it.

G3.rationale: The nine-month $68k field experiment has traceable accuracy, uncertainty, detection, deployment-time, and buyer kill thresholds.

G4.rationale: Named test houses and certification programs occupy adjacent territory. Whole-boundary variable-load field acceptance is distinct but absorbable.

G5.rationale: All observables and uncertainty propagation are established engineering; the differentiator is directly testable in one field installation.

G6.rationale: The CN route uses local instrumentation and calibration for civilian efficiency projects with no structural export block.

G7.rationale: The official 2030 heat-pump action plan and independent MIIT 2026-2028 actual-load evaluation program create a specific validation-then-acceptance sequence extending into 2030-2034.

candidates.concept: China-local dry point-of-use arsine-abatement cartridge platform for compound- and power-semiconductor exhaust
named_buyer_examples: Semiconductor fab operators represented by SDIC/China Electronics Engineering Design Institute procurement (CN)
Yixing CRRC Times Semiconductor power-device capacity project (CN)
candidates.painful_job: Arsine-bearing CVD and implant exhaust requires point-of-use destruction or capture, reliable endpoint warning, safe cartridge changeout, and manifested spent-media handling. A primary buyer has explicitly procured research on localizing dry POU adsorption equipment and secondary adsorbent performance.
candidates.product: An ambient-temperature chemisorption cabinet with process-qualified replaceable cartridges, a secondary guard bed, redundant endpoint sensing, digital exposure and pressure-drop history, and a local take-back and manifested-disposal service. Hazardous-gas qualification is performed only in a licensed partner laboratory.
candidates.noncosmetic_wedge: CS Clean Solutions CLEANSORB, Edwards, DAS, and Chinese central-scrubber suppliers already serve semiconductor exhaust. Sensors and dry beds are not new. The wedge is a domestically qualified arsine-specific media/cabinet pair plus secondary-bed evidence and closed-loop local cartridge take-back, matching the exact localization procurement rather than claiming a novel generic scrubber.
candidates.precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026: media screening with safe simulants and licensed-lab protocol. 2027: controlled arsine challenge against an imported reference cartridge. 2028: cabinet safety review and waste-disposal partnership. 2029: paid evaluation on a non-production bypass or qualified test manifold at a civilian compound/power-semiconductor facility.
candidates.launch_2030_timing_thesis: CRRC's Yixing project establishes a large active 8-inch power-semiconductor capacity base, while the official national 2026-2030 plan targets decisive integrated-circuit advances. Dry cartridges create recurring replacement and localization demand after equipment move-in, not only during greenfield construction.
candidates.demand_trigger_2030_2034: Recurring cartridge replacement, second-source qualification, and take-back service for the installed 8-inch power/compound-semiconductor base after the 2026-2030 capacity and localization cycle. Revalidate process-gas mix, waste classification, and import-substitution appetite before any 2030 production release.
candidates.competition_outlook_2030: Global incumbents have deep safety data and can localize media; domestic exhaust integrators can backward-integrate. This is not open whitespace. It advances only because the buyer's exact dry-POU arsenic localization and secondary-media request proves a narrow qualification socket.
candidates.china_route: Develop and manufacture the cabinet and media locally for civilian fabs, use licensed domestic hazardous-gas laboratories and waste contractors, screen end users, and exclude military facilities. The US market is not claimed because global incumbents and liability channels make it an inferior first beachhead.

first_experiment.design: Screen media with safe surrogates, then use a licensed hazardous-gas laboratory for controlled low-flow arsine challenge of a one-litre bed and guard bed against an imported benchmark. Include pressure drop, exotherm, endpoint warning, and spent-media leach testing.
success_thresholds: >=99.999% destruction/removal efficiency over the frozen challenge condition
Working capacity >=70% of the imported benchmark by normalized media volume
Endpoint warning >=30 minutes before the frozen outlet limit under the accelerated challenge
Guard bed remains below the frozen outlet limit after primary breakthrough
Spent media passes the prespecified licensed-disposal acceptance test
kill_thresholds: Any containment, removal-efficiency, warning-time, guard-bed, or disposal threshold fails
Thermal excursion or pressure drop exceeds the licensed laboratory's frozen safety limit
No licensed waste take-back partner or no paid fab evaluation by end-2029

G1.rationale: The SDIC procurement is exact-category dry arsenic POU localization and media-performance demand; the independent CRRC exhaust-equipment tender and capacity record establish an active buyer system.

G2.rationale: No academic performance claim is load-bearing. Incumbent product facts are used only to define the benchmark; startup performance must be generated in the licensed-lab experiment.

G3.rationale: The $86k licensed-lab experiment is bounded and has explicit removal, capacity, warning, guard-bed, safety, disposal, and buyer kill criteria.

G4.rationale: Exact global and domestic competitors are named. Buyer-specified local arsine media plus take-back is noncosmetic, but incumbent localization risk is high.

G5.rationale: Dry chemisorption is established. The experiment directly determines whether a local media/cabinet pair can meet safety and capacity requirements.

G6.rationale: Local civilian development, licensed testing and waste handling, end-use screening, and no US controlled-technology dependency define a reachable CN route.

G7.rationale: The 2026-2030 official IC plan and independent 8-inch capacity/tool-move-in evidence support a 2030 recurring-consumables window; the exact process-gas mix must be reverified in 2029.

candidates.concept: Vendor-neutral dirty-return helium purification and custody-mass-balance skid for cryogenic facilities
named_buyer_examples: Shanghai Jiao Tong University cryogenic laboratories (CN)
Ningbo Jianxin Superconducting magnet manufacturing and test operations (CN)
University and national-laboratory cryogenic facilities with existing storage or liquefiers (CN)
candidates.painful_job: Small and midsize cryogenic facilities lose helium because compressor oil, air, moisture, and inconsistent return pressure make dirty gas hard to accept into existing storage or liquefaction. Buyers procure complete recovery systems or outsource recovery, but have weak mass-balance visibility by user and experiment.
candidates.product: A vendor-neutral purifier front end with an oil-free compressor, membrane pre-separation, regenerable twin adsorption beds, trace impurity analyzer, automatic diversion, and custody-style inlet/output/loss mass balance. It feeds existing storage, liquefiers, or outsourced liquefaction; it is not a new liquefier.
candidates.noncosmetic_wedge: Quantum Design sells complete recovery and purification plants, Zhengfan sells fixed regeneration/circulation systems, and industrial-gas firms provide outsourced recovery. The wedge is a purifier-only retrofit with automatic dirty-stream diversion and auditable per-user mass balance for sites that already own downstream assets. It is noncosmetic but readily absorbable, so whitespace is scored 2/5.
candidates.precompany_plan_2026_2029: 2026: map contamination envelopes with one university partner. 2027: build the 5 normal-cubic-metre-per-hour skid and run 500 hours. 2028: integrate with existing gas bags/storage and complete safety review. 2029: require a paid pilot at a university facility or magnet factory and a service agreement with an existing liquefier or gas provider.
candidates.launch_2030_timing_thesis: The official 2026 national standard for ultra-low-temperature, low-noise superconducting-quantum-computing platforms and the official 2026-2030 quantum-technology program support more distributed cryogenic infrastructure. Ningbo Jianxin's filing independently documents recurring paid helium recovery/purification outsourcing in a superconducting-magnet operation.
candidates.demand_trigger_2030_2034: Recurring purification capacity and auditable loss allocation as quantum, superconducting-magnet, and big-science cryogenic facilities commissioned during the 2026-2030 cycle enter routine operation. The product launches below the liquefier layer and is killed if buyers demand only turnkey complete plants.
candidates.competition_outlook_2030: Quantum Design, Zhengfan, Iwatani, and local gas-service firms can bundle this functionality. The candidate is viable only if the purifier-only form factor retrofits two downstream architectures and the mass-balance record changes purchasing or user behavior enough to support a paid service contract.
candidates.china_route: Use a PRC-registered local entity, local compressor/adsorber integration, civilian university and magnet-manufacturing customers, and standard pressure-vessel and electrical compliance. No controlled cryogenic liquefier design is transferred.

first_experiment.design: Build a 5 normal-cubic-metre-per-hour purifier front end and run 500 hours on controlled 70-95% helium return mixtures spanning the frozen oil, air, and moisture envelope, using a partner facility's gas bag and storage manifold.
success_thresholds: >=99.999% helium output purity across the frozen contamination envelope
>=90% helium recovery from accepted inlet gas
Mass-balance closure error <=2% over each 24-hour run
Automatic off-spec diversion with no downstream contamination excursion
500-hour run without unplanned bed or compressor service
kill_thresholds: Any purity, recovery, mass-balance, diversion, or endurance threshold fails
Sellable purifier-only v1 cannot be built below $250k
No paid pilot or buyers require a full liquefier bundle

G1.rationale: SJTU's government procurement intention for a helium recovery system and Jianxin's exchange filing of repeated recovery/purification outsourcing are independent primary buyer evidence.

G2.rationale: No academic performance claim is load-bearing. Incumbent specifications are used as benchmark definitions and must be reproduced in the startup experiment.

G3.rationale: The 12-month $78k skid test has purity, recovery, mass-closure, diversion, endurance, v1-cost, and buyer kill thresholds.

G4.rationale: Exact complete-plant and service competitors are named. Purifier-only retrofit plus auditable mass balance is distinct but easily bundled by incumbents.

G5.rationale: Membrane and adsorption purification are established; the 500-hour test directly falsifies the claimed integration and operating envelope.

G6.rationale: A local civilian route using standard pressure equipment and no liquefier technology transfer is reachable.

G7.rationale: The official 2026-2030 quantum program and independent effective-2026 superconducting-platform standard support the installed-base trigger; Jianxin's filing ties it to recurring exact paid recovery work. Paid purifier-only appetite still needs a 2029 check.
